bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? The weight sensor updates while the scale is on and is unavailable while it sleeps.

user.description: Select your scale. If it is not listed, put something on it to wake it up and try again, or enter its address manually.

data_description.address: Chipsea based scales found by your Bluetooth adapters and proxies.

manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your scale. It can be set up while asleep and connects as soon as it wakes up.

data_description.address: For example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Colons, dashes or no separators are all accepted.

error.invalid_address: Invalid Bluetooth address. Enter six pairs of hexadecimal digits, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this scale is already in progress.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Chipsea scale.
